review_method: Human review of actual operation bodies and standard equations before any scanner invocation; generated anchors aid reproduction, not algorithm labels. Partial algorithm operation implementations count, API-only/generic math do not. No QCS imports.
api_reference_scope: Not scored. External calls do not establish an included implementation. In particular SM2 units do not inherit SM3 truth from their hash calls.
genealogical_limits: Crypto++ SM3 explicitly credits Krzysztof Kwiatkowski/Jack Lloyd code used by Botan; treat projects as separate repositories, not fully independent ancestry.
sm4ni reference/AES-NI variants share key schedule; openHiTLS SM3 default/small share public code.
Exact hash audit cannot prove absence of older upstream common ancestry.
